# TÜBİTAK UME — National Metrology Institute of Türkiye

## Snapshot

| **City** | Gebze (Kocaeli) |

## Why it matters internationally

UME extends the radiation-thermometry comparison infrastructure to
Türkiye: blackbody calibration and EMPIR-project participation tie its
radiometric scales to the European metrology network, the foundation on
which traceable emissivity measurement rests.

## Scope of activity

- **Quantities:** radiation thermometry · blackbody and IR calibrator calibration
- **Methodology:** Radiation thermometry and calibration of blackbodies and infrared calibrators; participant in European metrology (EMPIR) projects such as MultiFixRad. A dedicated material-emissivity bench is not confirmed from public pages; listed as extended pending verification.

**Application domains:** non-contact thermometry · radiometric calibration.
